correctness.rationale: Containment of a translated fixed vertical segment in tReeve is equivalent to its four endpoint facet inequalities. Decompose the base height w=mj+e and sum quadratic binomial fiber counts in j; ceil((L+e)/m) has two residue classes, yielding exact all-t truncated cubics and first positive dilation 2ceil(L/m). Factored eventual cubics have a simple linear root distinct from quadratic roots; quadratic discriminant m²−36mr+36r² never vanishes for positive integer parameters. Exact rational sign analysis yields two bands and m70 first high residue. Independent endpoint-facet enumeration of 672 cases and symbolic/factored checks agree.
